_note: LLM unit pricing for the cost tracker. Prices are USD per 1M tokens. fxUsdInr converts to rupees; override at runtime with env LLM_FX_USD_INR. Models are matched by the FIRST substring found in the logged model name (order matters). Claude (Bedrock) rows come first — their ids contain none of the later match strings, but a new model must never be able to inherit a Gemini rate by accident. Qwen (OpenRouter) rows next, specific-before-generic, so 'qwen/qwen3.5-flash-02-23' resolves to the Qwen row and never to the generic Gemini 'flash'. Gemini (Vertex list price) rows last: 'flash' before 'pro'. Vertex verified 1 Jul 2026; OpenRouter Qwen verified 19 Jul 2026 from openrouter.ai/models; Bedrock Claude verified 7 Aug 2026.
_bedrock_note: Bedrock Claude rates read 7 Aug 2026 from the Anthropic pricing table (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), which AWS's own Bedrock pricing page did not render for these models. THESE ARE GLOBAL-ENDPOINT RATES, which is correct because every modelId this build accepts carries the 'global.' cross-region inference-profile prefix. REGIONAL endpoints (e.g. an 'apac.anthropic.*' profile) add a documented 10% premium for Claude 4.5-and-later models — if a regional profile is ever used, it needs its own row at rate x 1.1, or it will be metered 10% light. No prompt-cache or batch rates here: this build uses neither.
